conventions.coordinate_route: P(q, -i d/dq) on the ket packet, then <bra|.>
conventions.momentum_route: P((i/2pi) d/dk, 2*pi*k) on the ket packet
conventions.note: collective-coordinate E1 kernel; not the 3D field-mode kernel of sm_momentum

packets.note: centres are deterministic functions of the index; widths are 0.55..0.63 per coordinate, 0.9 (bra), 1.1 (ket)

parameters.yukawa: fully populated complex 3x3 matrices, see sm_dictionary::fixture_parameters()

q_bearing_quadrature.note: q is a coordinate multiplication in the collective kernel and a 3D profile insertions in the per-mode kernel, so the two routes are not equal there; each closed form is checked term by term against an independent trapezoid evaluation of its own integrand, built from the term and the packet layout
q_bearing_quadrature.subset: the first four q-bearing entries of every family

three_d.note: per-mode 3D kernel (field insertions, spatial derivative on the ket); validated against its own coordinate route, and its derivative terms against the collective kernel
